Preference.app:summary: to start a chat tap the chat button at the bottom right corner of the chat fragment,select the device you want to chat the device must be corrently on bluechat and must not be farther than 15 meters from you,it is recommended to always select from the active or available devices in the select screen,bluechat will automatically initiate connection with the device you selected,if connection was successful you will be automatically launched into a chat screen and the connected device will be notified of your connection to it

Preference.app:title: Sending files
Preference.app:summary: when on chat screen you can send images,audios or videos to a connected device,these files can be selected from storage or captured directly from the camera,to capture a photo or video tap the camera icon at the bottom of the chat screen,select the type of file you want,bluechat will automatically open the camera app for you,once captured bluechat will automatically send captured data to the connected device\nTo select from storage tap the folder icon at the bottom of the chat screen,select the type of file you want bluechat will automatically open selected file storage for you,once selected bluechat will automatically send selected data to the connected device\nNOTE: chat buttons only appear if the device you are chatting is active

Preference.app:title: Voice Note
Preference.app:summary: Tap and hold on the mic button located at the bottom right corner of the chat screen to record,release it to send\nNOTE: you can only record voice note if the chatbox is empty

to start a call swipe right to the calls fragment from the start screen,tap the call button located at the bottom right corner of the calls fragment,select the device you want to call,if the device is not active bluechat will automatically initiate connection with the device,if the connection was successful bluechat will automatically initiate a call with the connected device and you will be automatically launched into the call screen\nNOTE: you can still navigate outside the call screen while in bluechat calls

Preference.app:title: Video Calling
Preference.app:summary: to start a video call double swipe to the video calls fragment from the start screen,tap the video button located at the bottom right corner of the video calls fragment,select the device you want to video call,if the device is not active bluechat will automatically initiate connection with the device,if the connection was successful bluechat will automatically initiate a video call with the connected device and you will be automatically launched into the video call screen\nNOTE: unlike the calls screen if you navigate outside the video call call screen the call automatically quits this is because bluetooth video calling is a heavy task and such not recommended to run in the background

tap the icon image at the top left corner of the start screen to open your profile settings,you can select icon from camera or from storage,to select icon tap the camera button below the icon image at the top of your profile screen,tap the popup camera icon to capture from camera or the popup folder icon to select from file\nNOTE: any device that connects to you automatically receives your icon

if you dont want a device to chat,call or video call you,from the select screen tap and hold on the device and select block from the popup options,confirm the alert dialog and the device will be blocked\nNOTE: blocking the device does not prevent it from discovering and connecting to you
